spec_match.rationale: Implements spec section 6.4's grammar rule by rule (three-digit 0-255 profiles, substream codec whitelist, mp4a-must-be-40.2, no trailing elements) mirrored against Chromium's ParseIamfCodecId, and asks the real isTypeSupported/decodingInfo next to the grammar verdict.

interactive.rationale: Editable string field, eight preset buttons (valid, malformed, and the Chromium test-only quirk), and a lint button; the rule list and browser panel update per run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises rule-by-rule lint plus the browser's real rejection; delivered, including the documented bare-'iamf' Chromium test-only quirk.

edge_cases.rationale: Malformed digits, out-of-range profile, foreign codec, non-AAC-LC mp4a, missing elements, and the test-only quirk each produce a distinct failing rule; the page states plainly that on a no-IAMF browser valid and malformed both answer false.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, spec section 6.4, and Chromium audio_codecs.cc.

conformance.rationale: The v153 suite's malformed-refused assertions are the immutable counterpart of this page's grammar column; 9/9 pass in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): preset iamf.999.000.Opus rendered 'Grammar says INVALID and this browser refuses it — consistent rejection' with isTypeSupported false and decodingInfo false; the valid string iamf.000.000.Opus rendered the honest cannot-separate explanation; console and network clean; screenshot v153-iamf-lint.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iamf-lint-ran per run and the falsifiable iamf-lint-no-invalid-accepted, which fails if any browser ever claims support for a grammar-invalid string.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; preset buttons override both background and color; rule marks pair glyph with text.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled input, grouped presets with role=group and aria-label, list-based rule output, and a role=status aria-live=polite verdict.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verdict panels reflow via auto-fit minmax(260px,1fr); responsive-check passes both classes; screenshots judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Confirm valid-vs-malformed separation once a browser decodes IAMF
openQuestions.detail: Today the browser columns answer false for both valid and malformed strings, so only the grammar column separates them. On an IamfAudioDecoding-enabled build, verify valid strings flip to supported while every malformed preset stays refused (the iamf-lint-no-invalid-accepted telemetry assert and the conformance suite will catch a regression).

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async result status live region without stealing focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce the outcome of a user-triggered check through one polite live region and keep per-item results as plain text in the document.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict line is role=status aria-live=polite; each grammar rule renders as text with a glyph, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: verdict text updated for both the malformed and valid presets

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap flexible control clusters and let panel grids reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .presets is flex-wrap and .verdicts uses auto-fit minmax(260px,1fr); the mono input is width:100% box-sizing:border-box.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 linter with milestone framing updated for the shipping-stage entry. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: malformed preset shows consistent grammar+browser rejection, valid string shows the honest cannot-separate explanation, clean console/network, both responsive classes pass.
